interface.longDescription: This skill should be used when the user asks to generate, edit, localize, composite, or batch-create images through an OpenAI-compatible Images API or a third-party GPT Image 2 relay. Trigger on explicit mentions of gpt-image-2, an image model alias, custom base URL, /v1/images/generations, /v1/images/edits, API-based image generation, prompt compilation or review for an API call, reference images, masks, or reproducible image run metadata. Do not select it solely for ordinary built-in image generation when no API or relay workflow is requested.
